skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Nuit of the Nightsky
skins.content: Misaligned Sightseer New Arrivals/Nuit of the Nightsky. Reed flutes and harps play in succession as jade lotuses gently float by. The night sky and melodic notes accompany Pepe in a moment where she has pushed everything else to the back of her mind.
skins.quote: One day, the stars will fall to the earth, entering the eternal cycles of history. As for the power to flip the pages of the chronicle of fate, that lies in Pepe's hands.
